invariants.rationale: fileName must be non-null for resource resolution and loading.
parameter is dereferenced for texture filter fields, so it must be non-null.
parameter.textureMinFilter is used in setTextureFilters, suggesting it is expected to be non-null.
parameter.textureMagFilter is passed to setTextureFilters, so should not be null.
A non-empty fileName is a reasonable precondition for loading a resource.
